song_title: Claptone & Sea Girls - Put Your Love On Me (feat. Henry Camamile) [Korolova Extended Mix]
thesis: Stage a masquerade-style reveal where warm monochrome gold evolves into rich amber-purple and finally blooms to warm white, mirroring the vocal plea in the title as an earned opening of light.

artist_branding.summary: The blend of Claptone theatricality, Korolova patience, and Sea Girls vocal warmth favors elegant dramatic pacing: opulent shadow-first scenes, gradual color bloom, and controlled peak release.
visual_cues: Masquerade warmth with amber and gold as primary identity tones
Purple luxury accents that enrich mid-to-late structural arcs
Earned warm-white bloom saved for true climax rather than early overexposure
do_not_copy: Do not reproduce exact mask iconography sequences, branded event visuals, or one-to-one choreography from official stage captures.

motifs: Geometry motif: broad split beams circling the room before converging into center declarations
Color motif: dark ember to amber and gold, then purple enrichment, then warm white bloom
Movement motif: all-mover active architecture with faster sweeps in drops and climax

visual_direction.color_story: Start near-black with ember tint, build through amber and gold dominance, layer purple in late build, and reserve warm white for the climactic bloom.
visual_direction.motion_story: Maintain continuous beam activity with 2-bar transitions in narrative sections and 1-bar transitions for drops and climax propulsion.
visual_direction.staging_story: Use split-position Sharpy/BSW pairings as core language while PAR and NI3K layers reinforce theatrical warmth and final bloom scale.

must_include: Warm palette family only; no cold cyan/blue world takeover
All movers active across key phrases with split coverage architecture
Climax must contain a distinct warm-white bloom moment with clear pre-bloom contrast
avoid: Early full-white exposure that removes climax payoff
Cold-color detours that conflict with masquerade warmth direction
Overly static center-only blocking in drop sections
